Bloodmoor

A physics sword-fighting game. Your mouse is your sword arm: the faster you swing, the deeper it cuts. Put your blade in the way to parry, and take limbs when you can.

Mode

Map

Your side
A side

How to play
Mouse
Move your sword hand. Push past the side (without LMB) to turn. Swinging never moves the view.
LMB
Hold while you swing for full power. Big, fast mouse sweeps hit hardest.
RMB
Hold to look around freely. Carrying a lantern in your off hand, it also lifts the lantern high
Wheel
Swords and spears: scroll to thrust; the point stays on line while you keep scrolling. Axes and maces: scroll changes your reach.
WASD
Move · Shift sprint · C crouch · Space jump and vault
F Q
Kick · hold Q to wind up over the shoulder, let go to throw from that hand
Alt X
Hold Alt to thrust (the same as scrolling forward, held) · X to change hands with a one-handed weapon
V M Tab
Close, wide or first-person view · music on/off · hold to look over your wounds
Esc
Pause
E
Take weapons and armor, or strip them off the dead. In the Crypt: open caskets, take a lantern (crouch and E sets it down), read a parchment, drink from a flask, or leave by the oak door. The way down is the hole in the great hall: there is no stair. Boards across the passage floor are rotten. Boards nailed across a door come off if you get a hand on them (G) and haul
LMBRMB
Unarmed: hold to take control of that fist and swing it with the mouse. Wheel jabs.
R
With a sword or knife: turn the grip over, point down, and click to stab down, into a man on the ground or over a shoulder. Keep the button down and the blade stays in; let go and it comes out. G lets go of a blade that's in someone and leaves it there; walk up and press E to take hold of a blade left in a body, then step back to pull it out.
Z
Put away what's in your hand (through the belt, or slung on your back if it's long), or draw it again. Pick up a second weapon and the first goes there by itself; Z changes between them.
G
With a one-handed weapon, hold it and your free hand reaches out and takes hold of what's in front of you: his sword arm (he can't swing it freely), his blade or haft (step back hauling and it comes out of his hand; a bare hand on a blade he draws back gets cut), his collar or head (step back and he's towed off balance and down), a body on the floor. Let go of G to let go; let go while hauling and he's thrown. Bare-handed, tap it to switch between fists and open hands. With open hands, a hand you hold out grabs whatever it touches: a collar, an arm, a body on the floor. Haul them off their feet, drag them, throw them. Knocked down or held? Rock A and D in turn to struggle free and get up sooner.
Left thumb
Move. Push to the edge to sprint. Rock it left and right to struggle when you're down.
Right thumb
Drag to move your sword hand. Swipe fast to swing hard; drag past the edge to turn.
Buttons
Thrust (hold) · Jump · Kick · Use (take weapons and armour) · Throw (hold, let go to throw) · Grab (unarmed) · Grip (with a sword: turn it point-down; Thrust then becomes Stab, hold it to keep the blade in) · Crouch · Wounds
Sensitivity

There are no bars: hold Tab to look over your wounds. You hear yourself breathe hard when you're winded or losing blood; tired arms drop the guard and swing weaker. Out of the fight, flesh wounds close; what's cut off stays off. Wild swinging burns your wind, turns your blade flat and glances off armor. Wind up, keep the edge true, and parry to leave them open.

In battle royale the ring of fire closes in, so stay inside it, and look for better weapons and armour lying about or on the dead. Plays with a keyboard and mouse, or with your thumbs on a phone.
